exact_response: Mocking white people can be harmless humor, but it isn’t automatically harmless. Context matters: a joke about cultural habits differs from racial slurs, targeted harassment, or treating someone as inferior because of their race. Power and history affect a joke’s impact, but don’t make every joke about a group harmless.
